hide-gm-changes.name: Hide Gamemaster Changes
hide-gm-changes.hint: If enabled, changes made by Gamemasters will not be tracked or announced.

track-all-owned.name: Track All Owned Sheets
track-all-owned.hint: If enabled, all sheets owned by a player will be tracked (preventing cheating on unassigned sheets). If disabled, only assigned characters are tracked.

track-concentration.name: Track Concentration
track-concentration.hint: If enabled, starting or breaking concentration will be announced in chat.

display-biography-changes.name: Display Biography Changes
display-biography-changes.hint: If enabled, changes to the character biography and personality traits will be announced.

sensitive-keys.name: Sensitive Keys
sensitive-keys.hint: A comma-separated list of keys to ignore when "Display Biography Changes" is disabled.

output-to-file.name: Output to File
output-to-file.hint: If enabled, logs will be saved to a .txt file in your Foundry data folder (Data/yugen-tracker-logs/).

log-file-name.name: Log File Name
log-file-name.hint: The name of the log file (e.g., combat-log.txt).

allow-player-log-viewer.name: Allow Player Log Viewer
allow-player-log-viewer.hint: If enabled, players will be able to open the log history viewer.

debug-mode.name: Debug Mode
debug-mode.hint: If enabled, detailed technical logs will be printed to the browser console.

show-sidebar-button.name: Show Sidebar Button
show-sidebar-button.hint: If enabled, the Log History button will appear in the Journal Notes sidebar and Directory header. If disabled, you must use a macro to open the UI.

discord-webhook.name: Discord Webhook
discord-webhook.hint: Enter a Discord Webhook URL to send logs to a Discord channel. Leave empty to disable.

announce-gamemasters.name: Announce to Gamemasters
announce-gamemasters.hint: If enabled, changes will be whispered to Gamemasters.

announce-assistant-gamemasters.name: Announce to Assistant Gamemasters
announce-assistant-gamemasters.hint: If enabled, changes will be whispered to Assistant Gamemasters.

announce-trusted-players.name: Announce to Trusted Players
announce-trusted-players.hint: If enabled, changes will be whispered to Trusted Players.

announce-all-players.name: Announce to All Players
announce-all-players.hint: If enabled, changes will be sent as public chat messages to everyone (overrides other role settings).

colors.title: Configure Colors
colors.hint: Set custom background and text colors for different types of log messages and players in the chat log.
colors.user-colors-hint: Assign custom background and text colors for specific users in the chat log.

log-viewer.title: yugen-tracker: Log History
log-viewer.logging-disabled-warn: Output to File is currently disabled. Historical logs will not be updated.

snapshot.title: yugen-tracker: Sheet Snapshot
snapshot.no-snapshot: No baseline snapshot has been taken for this character.
snapshot.no-changes: This sheet matches the snapshot perfectly.
snapshot.no-characters: No player characters found to snapshot.
snapshot.all-created-success: Taken sheet baseline snapshots for {count} characters.
